bagPolicy.summary: TD Garden discourages bringing bags to events to ensure safety and quick entry. Small bags, clutches, crossbodies, and wristlets are allowed if they do not exceed 4in x 6in x 1.5in. Oversized bags can be stored on-site for a fee.
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for diaper bags, breast pump bags, and bags needed for medical purposes, which are subject to visual or x-ray screening.

parking.note: The North Station Garage is conveniently located directly underneath TD Garden and is open daily from 5:00 AM to 1:00 AM. Visitors can also book parking with SpotHero for additional options.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare zone on Merrimac Street between 7 p.m. and 2 a.m. Follow the pickup location shown in your app.

concessions.note: TD Garden offers a diverse range of food and beverage options including pizza, burgers, vegan and gluten-free choices, sweets, and cocktails. Highlights include a $5 value menu and arena-exclusive snacks. Various bars and markets provide craft beers, cocktails, and family-friendly options.
stands: MRKT powered by Amazon's Just Walk Out Technology

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is on every level and varies by event, so say you need it when you buy tickets. Service dogs are allowed, but support or companion animals are not. Reserve an assistive listening device at least 14 days ahead through the ADA Info Line at 617-624-1750 or accessibleneeds@tdgarden.com.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: TD Garden has a strict no re-entry policy. For a personal emergency, ask a Guest Services Supervisor at Guest Services on Level 4, Loge 4; approval is at the supervisor's discretion.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office on Level 1, east side of North Station. Opens 2 hrs before event. Photo ID + credit card used at purchase required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Enter TD Garden through the East or West entrance, both reached from the North Station stop.
